scenarios.name: sustain_plus_pulse
scenarios.notes: Dyad A3/E4 with five isolated broadband clicks; sparse transients.

scenarios.name: dense_drums_with_sustain
scenarios.notes: Three-note pad under 168 BPM 16th-note drums; sustained tones overlap hits.

scenarios.name: quiet_sustain_loud_pulses
scenarios.notes: Sine-ish sustain at -20 dB relative to loud clicks; tests level sensitivity.

scenarios.name: vibrato_sustain
scenarios.notes: Counterexample: 6 Hz / +/-60 cent vibrato violates stationary-pitch assumption.

scenarios.name: noisy_sustain
scenarios.notes: Counterexample: 35% broadband noise inside the sustain is claimed as percussive.

scenarios.name: overlapping_attacks
scenarios.notes: Counterexample: note onsets coincide with transients, so onsets are ambiguous.

scenarios.name: glissando_sustain
scenarios.notes: Counterexample: octave glide violates stationarity; median line tracking drifts.

scenarios.name: percussive_drone
scenarios.notes: Counterexample: hard-gated 8 Hz drone creates periodic transients in a tonal source.

scenarios.name: homemade_mix
scenarios.notes: Hand-built: 3-note pad + irregular/overlapping clicks + noise bed. The bed has no ground-truth class; it is expected to split across residual.

homemade.name: homemade_mix
homemade.notes: Hand-built: 3-note pad + irregular/overlapping clicks + noise bed. The bed has no ground-truth class; it is expected to split across residual.
